notes.title: Official Comprehensive Guide now available!
notes.notes:
The comprehensive guide is now available to everyone who purchases the game on Steam. Sorry for the wait! This guide explains how to get every ending and collect every CG and memento. 

The guide is a PDF file that's located in the same folder where you've installed Break Chance Memento after you update to the latest version of the game. The easiest way to get to it is to right-click Break Chance Memento in your library, go to the Local Files tab, and then click the Browse Local Files... button. You should then see the BreakChanceMementoofficialguide.pdf file there. If you don't, please make sure that you've updated Break Chance Memento to the latest version in Steam.

We highly suggest playing through the game yourself first and only using the guide as a last resort, of course, but the guide has been made to be as spoiler-free as possible.

Thank you for your support of Cyanide Tea and Break Chance Memento! We really appreciate it. ♥
